experiment_data.hypothesis: 在 asymmetric confusion、group prevalence imbalance、且错误流向定向把高 CATE 子群迁移到低 CATE observed label 的 DGP 中，pooled/global correction 会因错误地假设对称平均误差而欠校正高效应子群、过校正低效应子群，从而出现 global PEHE 或 GATE bias 劣于 uncorrected 的区域。

spec.data_count: DGP directed_asym_prevalence_v1; k={3,6}; N={2000,5000}; reps=300 per config or seed x 100 equivalent
spec.device: CPU-only; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; do not use cuda:0

required_features: directed error flow between high/low CATE groups

k3.directed_flow: high-CATE group0 mostly misclassified into low-CATE observed label2; mid group1 leaks to low label2; low group2 rarely leaks upward

k6.directed_flow: high-CATE groups 0/1 preferentially migrate to low-CATE labels 4/5; low-CATE groups rarely migrate upward; matrix must be row-stochastic and asymmetric

spec.pass_fail: Pass if at least one predeclared directed positive-correlation config has global correction PEHE or GATE bias worse than uncorrected and subgroup/EC-HTE-lite improves PEHE/GATE bias or coverage; fail if no global-worse region appears across directed k/N grid.

gate.reason: Must not enter RUNNING until diag_dgp_bias_audit_001 mechanism is confirmed by Director/Reviewer.
